boards.name: East 57th Street Partners
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25 in a real browser: the firm's site is e57partners.com (east57th.com does not resolve; e57partners.com returns 403 to non-browser clients). Its Careers link is a JobDiva candidate portal SPA that lists client mandates without login (12 rows on 2026-08-25, including Executive Search: CTO/CFO/CEO, all dated 03/19/2025). Not enableable yet: rows use Details buttons, not anchors, so JSON-LD, selectors, and the anchor scan all yield zero; needs a JobDiva-specific extractor that reads the list and builds detail URLs. Listings observed were stale (5 months), so low priority.

boards.name: Korn Ferry
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: /executive-search/opportunities is 404. The public board is jobs.candidate.kornferry.com/jobs/ (Loopworks): the static page is a search form only and results load via a Kendo grid after a search is submitted. The capability object forbids form submission by design, so this board cannot be scanned without a policy change. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Heidrick & Struggles
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: no public list of client searches. /en/opportunities is 404; /en/careers is the firm's own staff hiring page (Workday) and leaders.heidrick.com is a registration-only candidate intake. Nothing to scan. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Spencer Stuart
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: no public list of client searches. /executive-search/opportunities is 404; only the firm's own Workday careers page and a login-gated candidate registration portal exist. Nothing to scan. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Russell Reynolds Associates
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: no public list of client searches. /en/opportunities is 404; careers-with-our-clients is a resume-submission CTA page with no listings (refers candidates to AESC BlueSteps). Nothing to scan. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Diversified Search Group (DSG / Odgers Berndtson US)
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-29 via non-browser GET: active-searches page is server-rendered with 150+ real listing anchors (page states Active (241)), no login, no form submission. No JSON-LD or datePosted found, so rows cannot be window-filtered by date. Detail pages are plain HTML with full text. pathPatterns includes the list page itself (/active-searches/) alongside the detail pattern: urlguard requires the list-page fetch to match a registered pattern too, not just extracted detail links.

boards.name: ChiefJobs.com (The C-Suite Job Board)
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-29 via non-browser GET: C-suite/VP/SVP board, about 10 rows on page 1 of 6, no login to browse or read detail, relative posted dates shown (2 days to 2 weeks old). No JSON-LD found; adapter falls back to anchor scan. Only page 1 is fetched. pathPatterns includes the list page itself (/chief-jobs/) alongside the detail pattern: urlguard requires the list-page fetch to match a registered pattern too, not just extracted detail links.

boards.name: ExecThread
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-29 via non-browser GET: browse/latest lists about 90 real listing anchors with posted dates (2026-08-27/28), no login wall on list or detail. By site design the company name and apply link are hidden on detail pages, so rows land as company Confidential with thin descriptions; expected, not a fetch failure. pathPatterns includes the list page itself (/browse/latest) alongside the detail pattern: urlguard requires the list-page fetch to match a registered pattern too, not just extracted detail links.

boards.name: Built In (Houston)
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-29 via non-browser GET: server-rendered, 12 real anchors on page 1 of 688, rows dated minutes to 2 days old, no login. builtinhouston.com is a parked domain; use builtin.com/jobs/houston. Broad tech board, relies on the title filter; only page 1 is fetched. pathPatterns includes the list page itself (/jobs/houston) alongside the detail pattern: urlguard requires the list-page fetch to match a registered pattern too, not just extracted detail links.

boards.name: WittKieffer
boards.comment: CHECKED 2026-08-29: /positions, /search-open-positions/, and candidateportal.wittkieffer.com each returned an empty shell to a non-browser GET (Salesforce Experience Cloud LWC). Likely JS-rendered SPA or login-gated portal; not distinguished without a real browser session. Needs a browser-mode check before enabling.

boards.name: TheLadders
boards.comment: CHECKED 2026-08-29: 403 to a non-browser GET (bot defense). Might work in browser mode; detail path pattern is a guess and unverified. Keep disabled until checked in a real browser.

_comment: Exec-search firm boards for the exec-generic adapter. The original five were verified on 2026-08-25: none exposes a scannable public list today. Retained-search firms (Heidrick, Spencer Stuart, Russell Reynolds) publish no client mandates; Korn Ferry needs a form submit the capability object forbids; East 57th is a JobDiva SPA that needs its own extractor. Six more boards were checked 2026-08-29: dsg, chiefjobs, execthread, and builtin-houston are enabled (fetch mode, verified live via non-browser GET); wittkieffer and theladders stay disabled pending a browser-mode check (empty JS shell and a 403 respectively). Every entry stays disabled unless verified; a wrong listUrl fails closed (CONFIG_INVALID) and never reaches the network. Sources rejected 2026-08-29 (not added, no config entry): Boyden (public list is nonprofit fundraising roles only); Wellfound (startup IC roles, noise); Heller Search, Riviera, Nexus, Kirk Palmer, DHR, Egon Zehnder, Stanton Chase (no public client-search lists); BlueSteps and ExecuNet (subscription-gated); Ivy Exec (no usable body, unverified); Odgers US (2 roles, PDF briefs only); CIO.com and Hunt Scanlon (editorial/directory, not boards); Otta/WTTJ (login-gated); Google Jobs and site: queries (no API / wrong domain for the adapter model).
